subject: Next steps: 30-min walkthrough + infra checklist for Carelynx
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@carelynx.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@carelynx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: 30-min walkthrough + infra checklist for Carelynx

Hi Elena / Carlos —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed next step so we can keep momentum: 

Highlights from today
- Primary use case: low-latency document summarization + triage for clinical notes.
- Key constraints: data residency in AWS us-west-2, strict retention windows, and SSO/IDP integration required.
- Success metric: maintain 95th percentile latency < 150ms for live queries under pilot load.

Proposed next step
We recommend a focused 30-minute product walkthrough (overview + brief infra/ops checklist) with the following goals: validate deployment option (Hosted vs Dedicated), confirm access requirements (SSO/KMS), and align on pilot timeline.

Slot options (PT) — choose one that works for your group:
1) Wed, Oct 28 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT
2) Thu, Oct 29 — 02:00–02:30 PM PT
3) Fri, Oct 30 — 09:30–10:00 AM PT

If none of these work, feel free to pick directly via our short scheduler: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min-carelynx

Please also let us know which internal stakeholders you’ll include (ops, security, product). I’ve attached a one-page pre-demo checklist and a draft mutual action plan to make the session efficient.

Attachments: draft-mutual-action-plan.pdf (PDF, 48 KB); pre-demo-checklist.md (plain text, 2 KB)

Thanks — happy to adjust.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Thanks Kim — useful recap.

We'd like to go ahead with option 1 (Wed, Oct 28 — 11:00 AM PT). Carlos (cc’d) will be our infra lead on the call; I’ll also invite our Head of Security if her schedule allows.

Two asks for the walkthrough:
- Please include a quick demo of how Redwood handles SSO integration (IdP metadata + typical steps).
- Can you surface SOC 2 / audit log retention options during the call?

If you can confirm the invite and add the pre-demo checklist to the calendar event that would be great.

Best,

Confirming Wed, Oct 28 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT. I’ve created a calendar invite and added Marissa (product engineering) to run the demo portion; she’ll cover the SSO flow and audit/retention options.

Google Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234efgh
Agenda (30 min):
- 0–5m: quick context & success criteria (Kim)
- 5–15m: product walkthrough (Marissa) — SSO + deployment options
- 15–25m: infra/ops checklist & pilot timeline (Kim + Carlos)
- 25–30m: next steps / mutual action plan confirmations

I also attached the pre-demo checklist to the event and uploaded the draft MAP to this share: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c4d5e

If Carlos or your security lead want any pre-read specific to SOC 2 (scope, controls we expose), let me know and I’ll send a short one-pager before the meeting.

See you Oct 28 — invite should arrive in a few minutes.

Best,
—Kim
